title: SearchResponse
description: Response envelope for the verana-graph faceted-search endpoint `POST /v4/graph/search` per [TG-FCT-6]. Each `hits[].snippet` MUST carry the per-surface core of [TG-FCT-6a]: the entity's primary key, `lastObservedAtTime`, the visibility flags applicable to the surface (`isTrustExpired` for `Did`, `archived` for `Ecosystem` / `CredentialSchema`), the DID binding on DID-bound surfaces (`did` on `Did` / `Corporation` / `Ecosystem`, `didId` on `ServiceEndpoint`), and the `Did`-surface flags `trusted` / `isCorporation` / `isEcosystem`. On the `Did` surface the snippet additionally carries the [TG-FCT-6b] field groups selected by the request's `snippet` projection per [TG-FCT-6c] (default set: `service`, `operator`, `corporation`, `endpoints`); an unselected group is omitted entirely, never `null`. Implementations MAY surface additional per-card fields (additionalProperties open). Per [TG-FCT-7] the `cursor` field is opaque and is the only way to fetch subsequent pages. All datetime values are ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 UTC strings (see `#/$defs/Iso8601DateTime`). See `### Search REST binding` in the verana-graph spec.

query.description: Echo of the request payload (per [TG-FCT-6]). Validates against `request.schema.json`; not re-validated structurally here to avoid coupling response validation to request constraints.

totalCount.description: Total number of records matching the filtered, gated query — not the size of `hits[]` (which is bounded by the request's `limit`).

hits.description: Page of ranked hits, ordered by descending `score`.

facets.description: Aggregations keyed by filter field name. Per [TG-FCT-6] the `facets` object MUST contain aggregations for at least every `eq` / `in` filter field declared on the queried surface in [TG-FCT-3].

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page, or `null` when this is the last page. Per [TG-FCT-7] cursors MAY become invalid; subsequent calls with an invalid cursor MUST return an explicit error rather than silently re-anchoring.

Iso8601DateTime.description: ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 datetime string in UTC.

Bech32Address.description: Cosmos bech32 address with the `verana` HRP. Used for `Corporation.policyAddress` and for the per-Participant `vsOperator` account; NOT used as a primary key.

Hit.description: A single ranked hit. The `snippet` shape is discriminated by `type` per the per-surface variants in `#/$defs`.

id.description: Primary key of the hit. DID for `type = Did`, integer VPR id for `Corporation` / `Ecosystem` / `CredentialSchema`, string id for `ServiceEndpoint`.

score.description: Final ranking score combining the [TG-FCT-4] lexical score with the [TG-FCT-5] trust signals. Absolute scale is implementation-defined.

snippet.description: Per-surface result-card payload; constrained by the discriminated `allOf` branch matching `type`.

highlights.description: Pre-rendered highlight fragments (e.g. with `...` markers around matched terms). Optional and implementation-defined.

DidSnippet.description: A `Did` hit snippet: the always-present [TG-FCT-6a] core plus the [TG-FCT-6b] field groups selected by the request's `snippet` projection ([TG-FCT-6c]; default set: `service`, `operator`, `corporation`, `endpoints`). An unselected group is omitted entirely, never `null`. Within a returned group, a field with no value MUST be present with value `null`, not omitted. Implementations MAY surface additional fields.

isCorporation.description: `true` iff the DID is the current `did` of a `Corporation` entry. Powers the Corporation badge and the `Did.isCorporation` filter.

isEcosystem.description: `true` iff the DID is the current `did` of at least one `Ecosystem` entry (equivalently: the `ecosystems` group, when requested, is non-empty). Powers the Ecosystem badge and the `Did.isEcosystem` filter.

service.description: [TG-FCT-6b] `service` group; `null` when the DID presents no `ServiceCredential`. Present iff selected (default set).

operator.description: [TG-FCT-6b] `operator` group; `null` when the trust chain is incomplete. Present iff selected (default set).

corporation.description: [TG-FCT-6b] `corporation` group; never `null`. Present iff selected (default set).

endpoints.description: [TG-FCT-6b] `endpoints` group — the DID's `ServiceEndpoint` records (the non-`LinkedVerifiablePresentation` `services[]` entries of the DID Document); `[]` when the DID Document declares no such entry. Present iff selected (default set).

ecosystems.description: [TG-FCT-6b] `ecosystems` group — the `Ecosystem` entries whose current `did` is this DID; `[]` when none (non-empty iff `isEcosystem`). Present iff selected (opt-in).

participations.description: [TG-FCT-6b] `participations` group — the DID's ACTIVE `Participant` entries. Present iff selected (opt-in).

credentials.description: [TG-FCT-6b] `credentials` group — the non-ECS VTCs presented by the DID. Present iff selected (opt-in).

DidSnippetService.description: [TG-FCT-6b] `service` group: the VS-level identity asserted by the `ServiceCredential`. The group is `null` (not this object) when the DID presents no ServiceCredential.

pattern.description: Architecture pattern (`Did.pattern`); non-null whenever a ServiceCredential exists.

description.description: `ServiceCredential.description`, optionally truncated for card use (truncation ends at a character boundary and is flagged with a trailing `…`).

DidSnippetOperator.description: [TG-FCT-6b] `operator` group: the operative ORG-or-PERSONA identity the VS's trust chain rests on (Pattern A: self; Pattern B: issuer), per the [TG-FCT-3] derivation. The group is `null` (not this object) when the trust chain is incomplete.

logoUri.description: Operative `OrganizationCredential.logoUri` or `PersonaCredential.avatarUri`; `null` for a Persona without avatar.

logoDigestSri.description: Paired `OrganizationCredential.logoDigestSri` or `PersonaCredential.avatarDigestSri`; `null` under the same conditions as `logoUri`.

registryId.description: Operative `OrganizationCredential.registryId`; `null` when the operator is a Persona.

address.description: Operative `OrganizationCredential.address`; `null` when the operator is a Persona.

DidSnippetCorporation.description: [TG-FCT-6b] `corporation` group: the owner Corporation's identity and trust signals, through the `Did.corporationId` anchor (the owner Corporation per the VPR DID ownership invariant). Never `null` as a group: `id` is always known; the other fields are `null` only while the owner Corporation record is not yet materialised (bootstrap transient).

id.description: Stable `uint64` id of the DID's owner Corporation (`Did.corporationId`). Never null.

deposit.description: Owner `Corporation.deposit` (Coin string); `null` only while the owner Corporation record is not yet materialised (bootstrap transient).

slashedEvents.description: Owner `Corporation.slashedEvents` (`0` when never slashed); `null` only while the owner Corporation record is not yet materialised (bootstrap transient).

lastSlashedAtTime.description: Owner `Corporation.lastSlashedAtTime`; `null` when never slashed, or while the owner Corporation record is not yet materialised.

slashedValue.description: Owner `Corporation.slashedValue` (Coin string); `null` when never slashed, or while the owner Corporation record is not yet materialised.

DidSnippetEndpoint.description: One declared service endpoint of the DID Document, per [TG-FCT-6b] `endpoints`.

id.description: DID Document service entry id (DID-relative URL).

serviceEndpoint.description: Endpoint value preserved verbatim per DID-CORE (URI string or object).

ParticipantRole.description: Participant role per the `Participant` entity table.

DidSnippetEcosystem.description: One `Ecosystem` entry whose current `did` is the hit DID, per [TG-FCT-6b] `ecosystems`. Archived entries appear with their `archived` flag — these are references from the hit, not direct Ecosystem-surface hits, so the [TG-FCT-2] gates do not apply to them.

participants.description: `Ecosystem.participants` — the Ecosystem's global per-role participant counts.

schemas.description: One entry per member of `Ecosystem.credentialSchemaIds[]`; `[]` when the Ecosystem owns no schema.

title.description: `title` of the loaded `CredentialSchema.body`; `null` when the body declares no title.

DidSnippetParticipations.description: [TG-FCT-6b] `participations` group: the DID's ACTIVE `Participant` entries (non-ACTIVE entries never reach the search surface, per [TG-ACT-1]; the full lifecycle view is traversal query A7). `entries` MAY be truncated to an implementation-defined maximum; `total`, `ecosystemCount`, and `byRole` always reflect the untruncated population.

total.description: Count of the DID's ACTIVE Participant entries.

ecosystemCount.description: Count of distinct `Participant.ecosystemId` values among them.

byRole.description: Map role → count over the same entries; `{}` when `total = 0`.

entries.description: One entry per ACTIVE Participant; `[]` when `total = 0`.

id.description: Stable VPR `Participant.id` — the G1 traversal anchor.

schemaTitle.description: `title` of the loaded `CredentialSchema.body`; `null` when the body declares no title.

DidSnippetCredentials.description: [TG-FCT-6b] `credentials` group: the non-ECS Verifiable Trust Credentials presented by the DID (`Vtc` records reachable via `Did —REFERENCES_VP→ LVP —CONTAINS_VTC→ Vtc`). ECS credentials (ServiceCredential / OrganizationCredential / PersonaCredential) MUST NOT appear here — they are projected by the `service` and `operator` groups. A presented VTC is by definition held by the DID (no role field). `entries` MAY be truncated to an implementation-defined maximum; `total` always reflects the untruncated population.

total.description: Count of distinct `Vtc` records presented by the DID.

id.description: The VTC's credential id (`Vtc.id`) — the B1 / B2 traversal anchor.

schemaTitle.description: `title` of the loaded `CredentialSchema.body`; `null` when the body declares no title.

attributes.description: The credential's `credentialSubject` claims verbatim, minus the subject `id` (the hit's own DID); `null` when the implementation has not fetched the VP body per [TG-DEREF-3] (the fetch is RECOMMENDED).

did.description: The Ecosystem's DID (mirrors VPR `Ecosystem.did`; MAY be shared across Ecosystem entries — the key remains `id`).

corporationId.description: Stable `uint64` id of the controlling Corporation (mirrors VPR `Ecosystem.corporation_id`).

id.description: Stable `uint64` primary key of the Corporation (mirrors VPR `Corporation.id`).

did.description: The Corporation's own declared DID (mirrors VPR `Corporation.did`).

policyAddress.description: On-chain account that signs on behalf of this Corporation (mirrors VPR `Corporation.policy_address`).

didId.description: The owning DID (the `Did` of the `EXPOSES_SERVICE` edge), per [TG-FCT-6a].

FacetAggregation.description: Per-value count for one filter field. Implementations MAY truncate to a top-N for high-cardinality facets.
